# Minimum example: same M, different uncertainty sets, explicit singularizing witnesses
A=matrix();D=np.diag([.25,1.]);Dd=diag_witness(2.,.125);Df=full_witness(A)
print('default_mu_sigma_Dupper',diag_mu(2.,.125),top(A),top(D@A@np.linalg.inv(D)))
print('diagonal_witness',Dd,'norm',top(Dd),'residual',np.linalg.svd(np.eye(2)-A@Dd,compute_uv=False)[-1])
print('full_witness',Df,'norm',top(Df),'residual',np.linalg.svd(np.eye(2)-A@Df,compute_uv=False)[-1])
print('unit_diagonal_simultaneous_extremes_poles',physical_poles(2.,.125,np.eye(2)))
print('allowed_full_norm_0p6_poles',physical_poles(2.,.125,np.array([[0.,0.],[.6,0.]])))
print('point_at_omega1_mu_sigma',diag_mu(2.,.125,1.),top(matrix(omega=1.)))
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10,3.2));ax[0].bar(['diagonal mu','full mu','D upper'],[.5,2.,top(D@A@np.linalg.inv(D))]);ax[1].imshow(abs(A),vmin=0,vmax=2,cmap='Blues');ax[1].set_title('Same M, not its diagonal entries')
for i in range(2):
    for j in range(2):ax[1].text(j,i,str(float(abs(A[i,j]))),ha='center',va='center')
plt.tight_layout();plt.show();print('structure_complete')

cells.code:
# Entire-frequency formulas; DC and infinity are evaluated separately from the log grid
freq_reports=[]
for c in [.125,.5,.8,0.]:
    peak=np.sqrt(abs(2*c));radius=1/peak if peak else float('inf');Delta=np.diag([1.,np.sign(c) if c else 1.]);poles=physical_poles(2.,c,Delta)
    row={'c':c,'exact_peak':peak,'radius':radius,'worst_constant_alpha':float(max(poles.real)),'scan_peak_with_DC':float(max(diag_mu(2.,c,w)))};freq_reports.append(row);print('frequency_case',row)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10,3.2))
for c in [.125,.5,.8]:ax[0].semilogx(w[1:],diag_mu(2.,c,w[1:]),label='c='+str(c))
ds=np.logspace(-2,1,401);ax[1].semilogx(ds,np.maximum(2*ds,.125/ds),label='feasible D upper');ax[1].axhline(.5,color='red',ls='--',label='exact mu')
ax[0].axhline(1,color='red',ls='--')
for a in ax:a.grid(True);a.legend()
ax[0].set_xlabel('Frequency rad/s (DC separately)');ax[1].set_xlabel('d');plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('triangular_c0_mu_sigma_D0p1',diag_mu(2.,0.),top(matrix(c=0.)),top(np.diag([.1,1.])@matrix(c=0.)@np.diag([10.,1.])))
print('frequency_complete')

# Real vs complex structure: exact algebraic counterexamples, not an approximate real-mu solver
print('scalar_i_complex_mu_real_mu_rho_sigma',1.,0.,1.,1.)
for delta in [-10.,-1.,0.,1.,10.]:print('real_scalar_residual',delta,abs(1-1j*delta))
print('negative_product_repeated_real_mu_complex_mu',0.,diag_mu(2.,-.125))
for omega in [0.,.001,1.]:
    eigenvalues=np.linalg.eigvals(matrix(omega=omega));print('repeated_real_eigenvalues',omega,eigenvalues,'exact_real_mu',.5 if omega==0 else 0.)
print('D_commutation_full_counterexample',np.linalg.norm(np.diag([.25,1.])@np.array([[0.,1.],[1.,0.]])-np.array([[0.,1.],[1.,0.]])@np.diag([.25,1.])))
print('real_structure_complete')

notebooks.title: 完整性能增广与四题复算

cells.code:
# Robust performance uses the entire augmented matrix, including both off-diagonal couplings
performance=[];fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,3.5))
for q in [.4,.6,.8]:
    a=.4;M=np.array([[a,1.],[q*a,q]]);d=np.sqrt(q*a);D=np.diag([d,1.]);peak=a+q;Delta=np.eye(2)/peak
    gains=[q/(1-a*delta) for delta in [-1.,0.,1.]];maxgain=q/(1-a)
    row={'q':q,'physical_radius':1/a,'worst_performance':maxgain,'augmented_mu_DC':peak,'D_upper':top(D@M@np.linalg.inv(D)),'witness_norm':top(Delta),'witness_residual':float(np.linalg.svd(np.eye(2)-M@Delta,compute_uv=False)[-1])};performance.append(row);print('performance_case',row)
    H=ctrl.tf([q],[1,1-a]);print('worst_parameter_Hnorm_exact',q/(1-a),'pole',ctrl.poles(H),'delta_corner_gains',gains)
    ax.semilogx(w[1:],abs(H(1j*w[1:])),label='q='+str(q))
ax.axhline(1,color='black',ls='--');ax.set_xlabel('rad/s');ax.set_ylabel('Worst real-parameter performance');ax.grid(True);ax.legend();plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('performance_complete')

# Four exercises: all original numeric assertions and witnesses are executable
print('Q1_mu_diag_full_d_radii',.5,2.,.25,2.,.5)
print('Q1_diagonal_witness',diag_witness(2.,.125),'full_witness',full_witness(matrix()))
print('Q2_nilpotent_mu_sigma_Ud',0.,2.,.2,'scalar_i_real_complex_mu',0.,1.)
for c in [.125,.5,.8]:print('Q3_peak_radius_alpha',c,np.sqrt(2*c),1/np.sqrt(2*c),-1+np.sqrt(2*c))
for q in [.4,.6,.8]:print('Q4_RS_radius_RP_gain_aug_mu_radius',q,2.5,q/.6,.4+q,1/(.4+q))
print('Q4_q0p8_specific_witness_det',np.linalg.det(np.eye(2)-np.array([[.4,1.],[.32,.8]])@np.diag([1.,.75])))
print('all_answers_complete')
